text:
alex: Heads up — PR #9721 is ready for review but blocked on an architecture signoff. I linked the RFC in the PR body but probably need a short arch summary there.

maria: Can you paste the RFC link here? can't find it in the docs search. :eyes:

alex: RFC: https://intranet.redwood/rfcs/runtime-fallbacks-2026-03-10 — it's the one about routing + fallback model variants. Short context: this PR wires shard-affinity routing and a secondary fast-path that falls back to a smaller model when KV cache misses.

devin: quick note — this touches leader election and routing table updates. we should call out implications for state sync during failover. pinging @sara-arch for arch eyes.

sara-arch: Looking now. Initial reaction: the design is reasonable but we need an explicit SLO delta and a canary rollback plan. Also want a 1-paragraph summary in the RFC about the fallback decision tree.

alex: understood. PR includes canary plan: `canary: 5% traffic for 12h -> 25% for 24h` and a rollback hook that flips `service/route` to previous config. I'll add the SLO delta note (expected +3ms p99 on large seqs, -10% cost on small seqs).

ben: Tests + CI look good except one flaky e2e. LGTM on unit/integration. If arch asks for short risk summary in the PR I'll add it. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: ci/build #9721: succeeded, ci/e2e #9721: 1 flaky test (tests/routing::test_leader_failover) — rerun recommended. CI details: https://ci.redwood/9721

maria: let's not merge until e2e is green. devin, can you reproduce the flaky test locally?

devin: repro steps: `make test-e2e TEST=tests/routing::test_leader_failover` — it times out intermittently on slower agents due to timing assumptions. I'll add a small harness tweak and a guard that retries once. Will push a fix to the branch.

sara-arch: Once tests are stable and the RFC has the fallback decision paragraph + SLO delta, I'm happy to give arch ack. please also add a line about why we prefer model-variant fallback vs. degrading batch size.

alex: will add both items now and update PR description. target: update by EOD. If anyone else can give a quick +1 after the update that speeds merge.

ben: I'll eyeball the safety doc after your update and +1 if it matches the canary/rollback.

maria: thanks — ping me when CI is green and RFC plus risk blurb are in the PR, I'll schedule merge in the next merge window.

alex: thanks all — will follow up here when pushed. :rocket:
